test_title: PYST 2: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

ECHO - CHEO - OHCE

URGE - RGUE - EGRU
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

ECHO → CHEO → OHCE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c93e94fb0887b251a11fa006691733bd5a8a23230050ef29c784cce9e5a822d6.png] 

URGE → RGUE → EGRU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0405f9f63ace92cb19d5d3a47f74091f6d63f164206520a3e7492d8becab094d.png] 

Now,

ECHO → CHEO

Here, the 1st letter shifts to 3rd position,

the 2nd letter shifts to 1st position,

the 3rd letter shifts to 4th position,

the 4th letter shifts to 2nd position.

So, the pattern is: **2 4 1 3** (based on positions).

CHEO → OHCE

Again, the same positional pattern **2 4 1 3** is followed.

Now, let's check each Option One by One.

Option 1) JOYS → OYJS → OYSJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a98fc30baa6b5cfd84f73b8c5b71b67d998629c2116c9d2dbf4756a1a3df7cb.png] 

Option 2) NAVY → ANVY → YAVN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57790461bdf42a51009da01dd0da317a4f696089ec2becbe7dd0bc15825e41fe.png] 

**Option 3) WAIT → AIWT → TIAW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e30580b00d9106d7bc612d085d71d9b4a67ce5b1c259ba24319faeae91279f26.png] 

Option 4) PAST → PSAT → TSAP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e92848c5fb6fcf62d68a4361174e251d5fbb74ceca5e7616cce937bcce7cd55a.png] 

So, Only **WAIT → AIWT → TIAW **follows the pattern of given letter cluster.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'**.
